text:
incident-bot: Pager: High 5xx rate detected on API gateway (502/504) — surge threshold breached. Region: eu-west. Spike start ~2m ago. Dashboard: https://dashboard.redwood.internal/alerts/4950016789 :rotating_light:
alice-oncall: Oncall here, starting triage. Assigning SRE. Any immediate customer-facing impact?
telemetry-bot: Topline: 502 rate 8.7% (1m), 504 latency increase on mux layer. Most failing upstream = router-proxy-3 -> connection_reset / 502. Traffic shift shows increased retries.
bob-sre: I'm on logs now. Seeing many connection resets and 502s with upstream 524/timeout markers. Looks like a protocol mismatch after the last edge-proxy deploy at 13:42 UTC.
carol-eng: confirmed — new edge-proxy build rolled at 13:42 (edge-proxy cluster). It introduced a connection pooling tweak. Recommend rollback to v2026.03.17-13:30 if SRE agrees. :warning:
alice-oncall: Rollback approved. Follow rollback playbook and enable mux fallback to legacy pool. Also notify support/CS with short status.
ops-bot: Rollback initiated: edge-proxy -> v2026.03.17-13:30. Jobs: rollout/rollback-edge-proxy (k8s) started. ETA ~3m. Command: kubectl -n edge rollout undo deploy/edge-proxy --to-revision=2
david-support: CS note: ~12 customers currently seeing request failures (mostly EU). Draft status: "We're investigating elevated 502/504 errors affecting EU region; mitigation in progress, next update in 15 minutes." Sending now.
bob-sre: After rollback + mux fallback, 502 rate dropped to ~0.9% (now). Recovering, tailing logs to confirm no residual regressions.
ops-bot: Rollback completed successfully across 3 pods. Health checks pass.
alice-oncall: Thanks. Marking mitigated but will keep channel open for monitoring 30m. Handoff to next oncall @eve at 14:00 UTC. Please add any post-incident notes.
carol-eng: I'll open a follow-up ticket to revert the pooling tweak and add a perf/regression test for connection churn.
david-support: CS sent customer update and is watching for escalations.
bob-sre: Closing active mitigations. Recommend postmortem to capture root cause and test coverage. :thumbsup:
